summary.text: Herman Quirmbach is a Democratic state senator for Iowa Senate District 25 and has served in the Iowa Senate since 2003.

paragraphs.text: The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Quirmbach as a retired Iowa State University economics professor with a B.A. from Harvard University and an M.A. and Ph.D. in economics from Princeton University, born in 1950 in St. Paul, Minnesota, and living in Ames.
It says Quirmbach served on the Ames city council from 1995 to 2003 and as Ames mayor pro tem in 2002, which the Iowa Senate Democrats' biography page also states.
